title: Support Solar and Win a 2025 Rivian R1T or R1S
text:
Skip to content
The Illinois Solar Education Association is hosting a raffle with a chance to win a Rivian and help fund solar and energy storage education at the same time.
ISEA has officially launched its 2025 Rivian raffle, and the prize is simple. One winner gets to choose between a 2025 Rivian R1T or a 2025 Rivian R1S. Truck or SUV, your pick.
Tickets are $100 each or 4 for $300, and only 2,500 tickets will be sold total, which honestly makes the odds way more interesting than most big giveaways. Entries opened August 4, 2025 and run through June 21, 2026, with the drawing happening June 25, 2026.
What I like about this one is that it is not just a random sweepstakes. ISEA is a nonprofit focused on solar energy, battery storage, and clean energy policy. The money raised supports education, advocacy, and helping more people adopt renewables. EVs and solar go hand in hand, so the pairing feels intentional instead of gimmicky.
Rivian’s whole brand is built around building vehicles with sustainability in mind, and whether you lean toward the adventure focused R1T or the family friendly R1S, both represent the shift toward electrification that groups like ISEA are pushing for at the policy and education level.
If you are already into EVs, solar, or just like the idea of supporting clean energy while taking a shot at a new Rivian, this is a pretty cool way to do it.
